shortDesc: Grid of practical facts about a country (capital, currency, languages, calling code, area, neighbours). Give it the country name or ISO code; it fetches the facts itself.

props.name: country
props.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "Portugal" or "PT".

styling.notes: Each fact on a warm white tile with a 3px sun-yellow left border; small uppercase labels.

interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'get country facts', country, outputFormat: { name, capital: [], currencies: [{ code, symbol }], languages: [], callingCodes: [], areaKm2, borders: [{ name }], region } }
